// REQ: LANG-2231 LANG-2232 LANG-2233 LANG-2234
/* outer /* nested */ comment */
class Greeter {
  construct new(name) { _name = name }
  greet(times) {
    for (i in 1..times) System.print("Hello, %(_name)!")
    return _name.count
  }
  static create() { Greeter.new("wren") }
}
var g = Greeter.create()
if (g.greet(2) > 0 && true) System.print(0x1F)
